connector.name: PeepTrend: YouTube Gaming Trend Finder
connector.registryDescription: Find rising Steam games and YouTube content opportunities before the niche gets crowded.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package peeptrend-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the domain namespace com.peeptrend. The registry required proof of control over that domain before accepting the record.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: PEEPTREND_API_KEY
env.description: Optional PeepTrend API key from Profile > AI integrations. Free checks can run with public limits; set this key for account-aware limits, full reports, generated ideas, saved plans, alerts, and subscription features.
